query:
SELECT
                COUNT(pk_systems.uuid) AS "count!"
            FROM
                pk_systems
            LEFT JOIN
                pk_system_fronters
            ON pk_systems.uuid = pk_system_fronters.system_uuid
            WHERE
                (
                    pk_system_fronters.updated_at IS NULL
                    OR EXTRACT(epoch FROM pk_system_fronters.updated_at)::bigint <= $1
                )
                AND uuid IN (
                    SELECT
                        uuid
                    FROM
                        pk_tracked_systems
                )
